624-3196-4808-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Phantasmal Image by paying {1}{U}, causing it to enter (with an additional Illusion type and triggered ability) as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Last Voyage of the ______ by paying {3}{B}.
When Last Voyage of the ______ enters, it triggers, becoming an Aura and returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Last Voyage of the ______ attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

6458-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
6458-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

643-6798-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-6798-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 3.

826-1636-4247-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
When Otherworldly Escort enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

586-728-5060-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
586-728-5060-5258-5618.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

620-2111-4779.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2073-2921-7876-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Consulate Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Consulate Dreadnought enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Consulate Dreadnought to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Consulate Dreadnought.
When Consulate Dreadnought dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

254-301-4738.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat from step 2

1417-2946-4871-6798.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1417-2946-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2999-3490-4050-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2999-3490-4050-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

5352-7487.notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
5352-7487.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Zealous Lorecaster and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Zealous Lorecaster tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other instant or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

292-1495-7315.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-7315.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-4585-6972.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Custodi Soulbinders.
When Custodi Soulbinders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

3771-4477-7182.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least four +1/+1 counters on it.
3771-4477-7182.description:
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid, Doun's Mind

5090-7203.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven other creatures
5090-7203.description:
Activate Brigid by tapping it, adding at least seven {G} or {W}.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Brigid
Repeat.

539-2557-3899-4324-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Workshop Elders.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4659-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4659-5789.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lotus Petal.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Corridor Monitor.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

997-5434-5555-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
997-5434-5555-6922.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
997-5434-5555-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Karlov Watchdog and causing you to draw a card.
During the opponent's turn, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4050-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

1129-3464-3657.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Allies.
1129-3464-3657.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1129-3464-3657.notes: If you get infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

3951-4050-4192-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Ashes of the Fallen on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-4050-4192-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

2084-4493.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
2084-4493.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

2099-5394-6291.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

478-804-1460-2821-4241.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
478-804-1460-2821-4241.description:
Animate Candelabra using Karn
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

565-1434-2909-6203.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} if Throne of Eldraine's chosen color is not "Blue"
565-1434-2909-6203.description:
If able, activate Throne of Eldraine's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast blue monocolored spells.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Throne of Eldraine.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a copy of Throne of Eldraine. Choose "Blue" as its color as it enters the battlefield.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

3180-5113-5220.description:
Cast Chamber Sentry either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Chamber Sentry enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Chamber Sentry on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2034-2288-2584-5003.notablePrerequisites: Tangled Colony has been dealt damage this turn.
2034-2288-2584-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tangled Colony, adding {C}{C}.
When Tangled Colony dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Tangled Colony from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Tangled Colony enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage equal to Tangled Colony's power to any target.
Resolve the Tangled Colony trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
When the Rat enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing 1 damage to Tangled Colony.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

777-1170-1177-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

859-1506.notablePrerequisites:
Burning Anger attached to Lurking Roper.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to give Lurking Roper lifelink.
859-1506.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, dealing three damage to any target and causing you to gain three life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

54-1399-2681-3814.notablePrerequisites:
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
The amount of creatures you control is less than your life total.
54-1399-2681-3814.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding {G}.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard and Wirewood Lodge.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding {B/R}.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Cast Rakdos Charm by paying {B}{R}, causing each creature to deal one damage to its controller.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

1558-4840-5222.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Sword of the Realms' equip ability by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Myr Battlesphere.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and sacrificing the four Myr tokens.
When Myr Battlesphere dies, Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Myr Battlesphere to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2744-3693-3828-4772.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Walking Ballista.
Walking Ballista has at least three +1/+1 counters.
2744-3693-3828-4772.description:
Activate Walking Ballista's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Druid's Call triggers, creating two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
The Squirrels enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade twice, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista, you may remove them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

148-3017-4869.notablePrerequisites:
An additional card in hand.
The number of cards in library is greater than each opponent's life total.
Keen Sense attached to Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
148-3017-4869.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Keen Sense triggers for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve one trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, repeat.
Repeat.

360-1610-1981-2034.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least three.
360-1610-1981-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Dingus Staff triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, causing you to create two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
The Soldiers enter the battlefield, triggering Soul Warden twice, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.
